project: Wuxia Life P115 Founding Patriarch Midlife Pressure Playable Implementation
description: Implement the minimum playable founding_patriarch midlife pressure stage based on P114 contract. Scope: single pressure choice event, checkpoint flags, expression updates, payoff gate reorder, bounded tests and closure evidence. No new systems, no broad rewrites.

userStories.title: Implement pressure core event and checkpoint
userStories.description: As a player, I can encounter founding_patriarch midlife pressure between on-ramp and payoff with correct age and gate constraints.
acceptanceCriteria: Add founding_patriarch_midlife_pressure choice event with age gate 40-45
Require founding_patriarch_on_ramp_done and !founding_patriarch_midlife_pressure_done before triggering
Set founding_patriarch_midlife_pressure_done on completion
Apply scholar > alliance variant priority
Do not change unrelated route logic
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add pressure branch flags and sequencing
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I can trace branch semantics and verify on-ramp to pressure to payoff ordering.
acceptanceCriteria: Set founding_patriarch_pressure_rule_first for branch A
Set founding_patriarch_pressure_alliance_first for branch B
Ensure both branches set pressure checkpoint
Sample chain shows on-ramp -> pressure -> payoff order
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Update player-facing pressure expressions
userStories.description: As a player, I can see pressure-specific identity feedback after the event.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement pressure cost-label signal for sect continuation burden
Implement pressure current-goal signal for rule inheritance plus alliance duty
Keep scholar and alliance variants distinguishable without splitting into a second event
Keep distinction from renown patron magnate expression semantics
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Rewire payoff gate to depend on pressure checkpoint
userStories.description: As a maintainer, payoff echo cannot fire before pressure completion.
acceptanceCriteria: Change payoff gate to require founding_patriarch_midlife_pressure_done
Keep existing lightweight payoff behavior once pressure done
Prevent payoff trigger when pressure checkpoint missing
Preserve P113 on-ramp behavior and compatibility
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add bounded tests and proof artifacts
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I can verify the P115 proof chain and key regressions with minimal targeted coverage.
acceptanceCriteria: Add or update targeted P115 tests for pre-pressure event checkpoint expression payoff gate chain
Cover scholar and alliance variants with at least one sample each
Output chain proof artifact under docs/test-reports
Run minimal required regression checks for P37 P113 P102-P112 and guard baseline boundaries
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Produce P115 closure report
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a closure report with implementation evidence, boundaries, and GO/NO-GO decision.
acceptanceCriteria: Output docs/test-reports/p115-founding-patriarch-midlife-pressure-closure-report.md
Summarize implementation proof and regression boundaries
Clarify deferred items including multi-event pressure and later-life expansion
State GO or NO-GO for post-P115 stage
Typecheck passes
